journeyTitle: Your data. Your choice. Your control.
journeyIntro: A simplified view of the privacy risks people can face online — and the privacy-first direction we are exploring with SafeMobile.
journeyStep1Text: When you use an app or service, information may travel across networks and services.
journeyStep2Text: Third-party trackers and profiling technologies may observe activity across apps and websites.
journeyStep3Text: SafeMobile now has a signed Android build with local inspection, limited static indicators and user-directed response tools. Detection performance is still being validated; public Google Play availability is not confirmed.
journeyStep4Text: Clear choices, privacy-conscious defaults and transparent controls should keep people in charge.
journeyFootnote: This overview describes the current development direction, not certified protection, guaranteed detection or confirmed public availability.
aboutDescription: We are building useful digital products and exploring responsible technology — connecting people with the tools they need while keeping privacy and security in focus.
productsDescription: A growing collection of thoughtful digital tools — from everyday Android utilities to research-led privacy and security initiatives.
safeDescription: SafeMobile is an Android security app in active development. Signed build 1.0.18 is prepared for Play Console handoff, with local-first APK inspection, limited static DEX indicators, device-posture insights and user-controlled response tools. Public Google Play availability has not been confirmed.
